title: Level order traversal
statementMd:
Return the values level by level as a list of lists. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `level_order([3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7])` returns `[[3], [9, 20], [15, 7]]`.
hints: BFS with a queue, processing one level at a time.
